name: LookAheadSchedulePlanner
tagline: Three-week look-ahead, make-ready constraints and weekly commitments with PPC – inside Power Apps.
description: A complete Last Planner-style look-ahead planning app for general contractors and trade partners. Break the master schedule into crew-sized activities, see them on a three-week look-ahead chart, track every make-ready constraint with need-by dates and at-risk alerts, commit only sound work in the weekly work plan, close each week with outcomes and variance reasons, and follow Percent Plan Complete (PPC) week by week. Missed work is re-planned without losing PPC history.
features: Three-week look-ahead on working days, grouped by area, trade, milestone or foreman
Make-ready constraints log with categories, need-by dates, overdue and at-risk detection
Readiness rules: only sound work can be committed
Weekly work plan with foreman commitments, crew-days and close-week
PPC per week, rolling 4-week PPC, target line and history
Re-plan missed work as new commitments (keeps PPC history)
Status workflow with reasons, confirmation and undo
Search, filters, grouping, bulk actions and CSV export
Demo mode with fictional construction data
